bibliographic.title: Blue Velvet
bibliographic.author: sanakan0
bibliographic.description:
"one more night in this horrible futuristic city... what's the worst that could happen?"

a short story about the different destinies of everyone living together in the same cyberpunk futuristic city.

play it in full screen for a better experience

TW: swear words, broken bones.

made for the Dialogue Jam.

well that's it, it's pure dialogue.

was a challenge to do it without descriptions as the Jam rules said, but it was fun :)

  • cover made by hideo k- sanakan0
  • a game by hideo koji- sanakan0
